payload.blocks: Only the move of Miu (secretary) to a fresh account; every plan keeps running.
payload.headline: Who runs the account probe for Miu's quota, since a confined supervisor cannot see accounts?

parts.cause: The supervisor head runs confined: `fgos dispatch probe-account --all` returns no accounts and config reports accounts as unavailable-confined, and probe-account is outside the supervisor grant. Asking an unconfined peer session to run it for me would step around that fence, so I did not.

options.does: Owner runs `fgos dispatch probe-account --all --json` in an unconfined shell and answers with the account that has headroom; the supervisor then patches personas.secretary.pool and replaces Miu (stop then start).
options.gain: Keeps the confinement fence; minutes of owner time; the swap afterwards is fully mine.
options.harm: Needs the owner at a shell once.
options.label: Owner runs the probe on the host

options.does: Owner orders the OPC host session (forgent-67) to run the probe and report; supervisor does the pool patch and the swap.
options.harm: OPC is busy staging a release; the probe opens panes during that build.
options.label: Owner tells OPC to run it

options.does: Add a host-side probe verb to the supervisor row of GRANTS through a plan.
options.harm: Not urgent-sized; a plan change, not today's fix.
options.label: Grant probe-account to the supervisor

parts.recommendation: Owner runs the probe on the host and names the account with headroom; I patch the pool and replace Miu without spending a live seat's refresh token.

scope.allows: Supervisor patches personas.secretary.pool to the named account or pool and stops then starts the secretary head once.
scope.forbids: Touching any live seat's login or refresh token; changing other personas' pools.

parts.what: Owner order 13:37Z: probe every account and pool, report headroom, rotate Miu onto a fresh account. Miu's pool is claude-miu (.fgos/config.yaml personas.secretary.pool), one account vantt.
